task: cover the Kesmark bridges from low-flying attack from the main position west of the bridges
short_ru: прикрыть мосты Кесмарк от ударов с малых высот
area_ru: западнее мостов, у дороги на Лазне
reasons: The bridges carry the group's supply over the Rava.
The enemy has struck crossings twice since the war began, from the west and south-west, low.
From Vrbice the battery's zone reaches the bridges only at its edge.

situation.text: strike aircraft low along the Rava valley and over the Lazne road
helicopters along the river's south bank

habits: The enemy comes at dawn and at dusk, under jamming, and has fired anti-radiation missiles at our radars.

area.notes: The main position by the order; the reserve within 2 km; a dummy at the crossroads.

readiness_text: no. 1 at dawn and dusk, no. 2 otherwise
coordination: the ZU-23 battery at the bridges' east end
our fighters' corridor north of Kesmark
call signs and frequencies as the communications diagram
reports: «к бою готов» to the regiment's command post by radio on arrival
support: the TZM at the reserve position
fuel from the regiment's rear at first light
source: sam3d: a fictional order in the form of voenizdat_osa_1991 pp. 240-245 (the working map's contents); the reasons and the situation are the campaign's (docs/campaign/03_THE_BATTERY_MISSION.md section 2's example)
notes: Battery 21's first task: from its position by Vrbice to the fields west of the Kesmark bridges, ready 90 minutes after the order.
